# T-3: Record cache hit evidence

## Goal
Expose cache hits through metrics or runtime logs without inflating real provider call counts.

## Acceptance Criteria
- R5 is satisfied by cache-hit evidence visible in metrics or runtime logs.
- R5 is satisfied while provider callCount remains the count of real provider invocations.

## Implementation Notes
Prefer the existing append-only flow metrics path when active flow context exists. If runtime log evidence is used, keep it explicit enough to distinguish cache hits from provider calls.

## Test Strategy
Add spec-local tests with `// spec: R5 ...` headers and update focused shared metric aggregation tests only if production metric shape changes.
